role_and_message.evidence: The derivative preserves the three RGBD pipeline comparisons: separate encoders with fusion, a unified RGBD encoder, and depth-derived geometry guiding an RGB encoder, each followed by a decoder.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: Panels (a), (b), and (c) retain both modality inputs, all encoders and decoders, the Fusion module, Geometry Prior block, depth example, and design-focus markers.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Original panel letters, module names, modality labels, design-focus legend, and three pipeline captions remain legible and unchanged in meaning. No original equations or numerical values are omitted.

connections_and_direction.evidence: The dual-encoder interaction arrows and fusion-to-decoder connection remain intact. Both inputs still enter the unified encoder in (b). In (c), depth enters Geometry Prior, which points upward into the RGB encoder; the encoder then feeds the decoder.

visual_encodings.evidence: RGB inputs retain their colored gradients and depth inputs their grayscale gradients. Peach encoder/decoder blocks, pale-green highlighted modules, bulb markers, and dashed panel separators preserve their original roles.

examples_and_data.evidence: The Geometry Prior block retains the same recognizable grayscale depth scene. No new example, measurement, class label, or experimental outcome is introduced.

unsupported_additions.evidence: The added sidebar connects depth and spatial distances between patches to a geometry prior and self-attention weights for RGB features. This follows the supplied abstract and introduction. Its statement that no additional depth encoder is needed is also supported by the supplied text.

complete_visible_content.evidence: The full derivative contains all three original panels and the complete explanatory sidebar, with readable labels and intact output arrows. Cropped text at the boundaries of the supplied detail views is visible completely in the full derivative.

remaining_limitations: Assessment uses the supplied images and source text. The reported pixel proof applies only to its listed rectangle; its file was not independently inspected. Retained source resolution and visual blemishes are independently scored; no quality-informed reroll.
